answer: Standing behind a name costs a £16 filing charge plus 6 days of processing per application, and the karst is that the stand-in must appear in person for every name, one at a time. Someone real must stand behind each name: Enrolled embroiderer craft licence issued by the embroiderers guild insists on it, since a licence embroiderers renew after stitch audits. An honest agent finds one person once; a farm finds a hundred, and the summit is a diary of appearances while the anchor never rises to match.
